BiblicalUsage: Ke-an is the Aramaic word for now, at this time. Ezra 6:6 opens the king's order with now therefore, and Daniel 2:23 has Daniel thanking God who hast made known unto me now what we desired.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe now is God's favourite word: he answers in this time, not only in some later one.
